title: Control Flow [Else]
description:
Now that you know if, you may be thinking "_Hey, wait what if I want somthing to run both if somthing happens **And if it doesn't happen**_". That is exactly what `else` is for. You put `else` after the closing brace of an `if` statement. What it does is IF the `if` statement doesn't run, it runs the `else` branch. Simple, right?

---
